svg.title: Three aromatic protons → three spin systems
svg.desc: Vanillin drawn from its structure with the three aromatic protons colour-coded by spin system, H2 a meta doublet, H5 an ortho doublet, H6 a doublet-of-doublets, each linked by colour to its multiplet in the 300 MHz 1H NMR spectrum beside it
